text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > .audit/category-toolbar/decisions.md <<'EOF'
# Category toolbar

The domain states remain RankingCategory, ReportingPeriod, UpdateCategory and UpdateSort. Feature data owns committed selection. Shared UI owns native presentation and resolves DOM strings through supplied typed options. UpdateSort is derived from its canonical labelled options.

Compared reusing navigation for local updates, building an ARIA tablist, and using native pressed buttons with the existing tab appearance. Native pressed buttons preserve the existing keyboard, focus and local switching contract without fake destinations or a new tabpanel interaction model. Rankings retain native links. Type System Discipline changed Select to return only values found in the supplied typed options. Model the Domain changed sort labels and values into one canonical option registry.

Compared a feature-specific period dropdown with a PeriodSelector presentation variant. Chose the variant so URL cleanup and scope ownership stay centralized. The default link presentation stays on entity Summary views.

Committed selection is deliberate during pending navigation. Select restores its native DOM value before emitting a request; the label changes with committed page data. A subsequent category click uses the currently displayed period, cancelling an unfinished period change rather than mixing destination scope with committed labels. Shared Select does not fetch or interpret financial data.

Throughput checkpoint. One exclusive writer, one build at a time, fixture-backed Playwright for controls and financial output. No Docker mutations, commits, pushes or PR actions delegated to this worker. Parent owns review and delivery.
EOF

Implemented category toolbars, native typed dropdowns, shared button tabs, docs, gallery and tests. Entity Summary filters retain default layout. Pending rankings selection stays committed; category navigation preserves scroll and query state.

- Final check/build passed.
- Full suite had 200 passes and one test setup failure, corrected and verified.
- Final affected run had 49 passes and one new scroll assertion failure, corrected.
- Final rankings run passed 4/4.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Logs and decisions are in `.audit/category-toolbar`.

No commit, push, PR or Docker changes. Port 4179 is Docker-owned; parent must rebuild that preview and capture screenshots.
